# (Datamining) Battle Banners: Battle-Focused Lunchboxes (Scout Banners)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_25_nukaknights-post-scoutbanners.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Update: December 6th, 2022 Battle banner description from the patch notes

### SEASON 11: NUKA WORLD

Nuka World is much more than just a roadshow - today's update features a brand new Nuka-Cola themed season that should quench your thirst! Travel the Nuka World and visit iconic locations like Dryrock Gulch, Safari Adventure and many more. Complete daily and weekly challenges to unlock S.C.O.R.E. and unlocks new items like the Sheepsquatch Power Armor wrap, C.A.M.P. items, consumables, a new distant ally, and more!

This season we are introducing a brand new reward to the board: the **Scout Banner**. As honorary members of the Scout Pioneers, you have been entrusted with a banner that you can use in battle to give you and your team a boost that should turn the tide of battle. The banners grant you and all nearby players one of five temporary bonuses.

**The bonuses are as follows:**

**Combat Medic:** Heals 20% HP.
**Combat Controlled:** Restores all AP.
**Battleforged:** Resets weapon wear by 10%.
**Battle Hardened:** Resets armor wear by 10%.
**Combat Vision:** Enemies are highlighted for 5 seconds.

See: Fallout 76 - Nuka World on Tour Patch Notes – December 6th, 2022 (Patch 40)

## Original post

Dataminer DSJ has found new buffs in the PTS files that are supposed to work similarly to lunch boxes. These buffs are expected to come to us in Patch 40 (Nuka World Update).

"Scout banner" is a possible translation. In English they are called “Scout Banners”. Something like “boy scout banners” or “scout flags” or similar would also be conceivable.

**Update:** Apparently the German name is now "**kampfbanner**".

For the first time, you will receive them in the weekly rewards for the Axtionism Challenges from November 15th to November 29th, 2022

![](/uploads/scoutbanners-datamining.png)

There is already an official text about it:

Scout Banners are consumable items that you can open to receive various buffs to help you in battle: Scout Call, Scout Code, and Scout Courage. Scouting Call is a buff that adds a 5% (max 20%) chance to trigger a Scouting Code buff when you kill an enemy. Scout Codex are various buffs designed to help you keep fighting. Each Scouting Banner applies a random Scouting Code. Scouting Courage is a buff that automatically revives you with a Stimpak every 5 minutes when you are incapacitated.

Opening a Scouting Banner applies Scouting Codex, a random Scouting Codex, and Scouting Courage to not only you, but every player near you. Other players may not receive the same Scout Code as you.

Scout call:

Scouting Call gives a 5 - 20% chance to trigger ALL active Scouting Codex buffs when you kill an enemy. Each Scouting Banner that affects you increases the chance of triggering Scouting Codex buffs by 5%. This effect increases the overall proc chance by up to 20%. Any Scout Banner that affects you when you have reached the 20% bonus effect will update the effect timer. Scout Call lasts 60 minutes and pauses when you exit the game.

Scout Code:

The Scout Banner assigns the player a random Scout Codex. Scouting Codex are effects that trigger when Scouting Call is triggered on an enemy. There are 5 possible effects, and players can only have a single copy of an effect on them at a time; If the player would receive the same effect, the timer for the effect will be updated.
